import os
import stripe
from agents import function_tool
stripe.api_key = os.environ['STRIPE_API_KEY']
PRICE_CENTS_PER_MONTH = 499

@function_tool
def buy_cloud_recording_plan(customer_id: str, camera_id: str, months: int) -> dict:
    amount = PRICE_CENTS_PER_MONTH * months
    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    method = customer['invoice_settings']['default_payment_method']
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amount, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, payment_method=method, off_session=True, confirm=True, description=f'Cloud recording for camera {camera_id}, {months} months', metadata={'camera_id': camera_id, 'months': str(months)})
    # Cancel any existing active recurring subscription for this camera, now replaced by the prepaid plan
    existing = stripe.Subscription.list(customer=customer_id, status='active')
    for sub in existing.auto_paging_iter():
        if sub['metadata'].get('camera_id') == camera_id:
            stripe.Subscription.cancel(sub['id'])
    return {'payment_id': intent['id'], 'amount_cents': amount, 'status': intent['status']}
